theme_central: Fulfilling covenants (al-wafa' bil-'uqud) — toward Allah, between people — through the history of covenants broken by the Children of Israel and the Christians.
sources_note: 4-part structure following imamghazali.org (Thematic Explanation); the last surah revealed in its entirety (verse 3 = the last verse revealed).

branches.title: Foundations of the covenant
branches.resume: Respecting contracts, lawful food, purification, reminder of the covenant.

children.t: Respecting contracts, lawful food (halal), ritual slaughter, completion of the religion
Reminder of the covenant, justice even toward an enemy people

branches.title: Broken covenants, the People of the Book
branches.resume: History of the covenants broken by the Children of Israel, then critique of the Christian trinitarian dogma.

children.t: Broken covenant, Musa and the 40 years of wandering in the Holy Land
The account of Adam's two sons (Cain and Abel)
Fighting corruption on earth, punishment for theft
Warning against judging by laws other than Allah's
Alliances not to be formed against the faith, reciprocal warning

branches.title: Moral and social rules
branches.resume: Dietary and ritual prohibitions, the sanctuary of the Kaaba, rules of witnessing.

children.t: Not forbidding good lawful things, expiation for a broken oath
Prohibition of wine and games of chance
Prohibitions of the pilgrimage (hunting), sanctity of the Kaaba
Not asking embarrassing questions, rules of testamentary witnessing

branches.title: Eschatological accountability
branches.resume: Allah questions the messengers, the table spread requested by the disciples of Aissa, final judgment.

children.t: Allah questions the messengers on the Day of Judgment
The table spread (al-ma'ida) requested by the disciples of Aissa
Aissa disavows the divinity attributed to him
